known.via: English Wikipedia "Goriška Brda" (redirects to "Gorizia Hills") (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A hilly area in western Slovenia, on the right bank of the Soča (Isonzo) River and shared with Italy, mostly making white wine. Ribolla Gialla is the most planted grape at 21 percent, then Chardonnay and Merlot at 16 each.
